versions.short: The bill would stop the Governors of the Postal Service from approving any bonus, award, or other extra pay beyond basic pay for the Postmaster General or the Deputy Postmaster General in any year when the Postal Service fails to meet 95 percent on-time delivery for each on-time delivery target set for a market-dominant product category, or when it exceeds a prior-year deficit or runs a deficit after a prior-year surplus. The bill would also require that a certain report be submitted to the Postal Regulatory Commission as well as to its existing recipients.
